Commentary.Commentary: However, Pakistan did not allow the English batsmen to settle in and took wickets at regular intervals. Hasan Ali and Mohammad Amir led the tourists' comeback, picking up 7 wickets between them, to keep the total down. They still face an immense task ahead as their batting is not in the finest shape. Join us shortly for the run chase.

An excellently balanced innings. England managed to cross the 300-run mark by the skin of their teeth but were much better positioned at one point. They were off to a lightning start thanks to Jason Roy's 87. Ben Stokes was off to a slow start but the slow burner picked up pace later and guided England through the first half.

Short ball on middle and leg, Wood goes for a pre-determined pull shot but is struck on the shoulder. The ball doesn't go far but it is the last ball and the batsmen go for the single. ENGLAND FINISH ON 302/7!
Another short ball and hard pull shot to the leg side. The batsmen pick up a single.
Short ball outside off, Jordan launches into a wicked pull shot that sends the fielders scampering. Two runs added to the total. 300 UP FOR ENGLAND!
Shortish delivery and Jordan swings for it but misses.
SIX! Monstrous! Length ball on the stumps, Jordan lofts it. This one goes high and doesn't show any signs on stopping. That was one big maximum.
Short around off, Mark Wood pulls it hard, getting a top edge and the ball falls just short of Nawaz at mid-wicket.
Full delivery around off, pushed to the off side for a single.
Length ball outside off, pushed to the covers for a single.
Full outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
FOUR! EDGED! Length ball outside off, Wood looks to play it to the off side but the ball takes an outside edge and goes past the keeper to the third man boundary.
Fullish ball on the pads, Jordan looks to flick it but is hit on the pads. The batsmen run a single and the fielding side appeal for LBW but the umpire signals a leg bye.
MARK WOOD is the last man in.

OUT! Caught in the deep! Short ball outside off, Willey falls for it. He launches into a big pull. Unfortunely for him, he can't put enough power to send it over the square leg boundary and Mohammad Nawaz in the deep waits and takes an easy catch.
HASAN ALI is back on.
A slower bouncer to fox Jordan, the batsman looks to pull it hard but is beaten by the bounce.
Full outside off, driven down the ground for a single.
Jordan has worked it off his pads behind square. They pick up a single.
BOUNCER! Jordan sees it coming and ducks.
Length ball around off, blocked off the back foot to mid off.
Length ball on middle, defended off the back foot to square leg.
UMAR GUL is back on.
Shortish ball on middle and leg, nudged to the leg side for a single.
Full on middle and off, worked to square leg. Pakistan are looking alive after getting those wickets.
Yorker outside off, Willey digs it out to mid off.
Length ball on middle and leg, flicked to the leg side for a single.
Fuller ball on leg, worked to mid-wicket for a single.
BOUNCER! It goes outside off, but Willey shies away from it hurriedly.
Short and around off, Willey decides to go for it, pulling it hard. The ball flied over square leg, bouncing just ahead of the man in the deep. The batsmen run a single.
Another short ball, well left by Willey.
Shortish ball, defended off the back foot.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Willey swings for it but misses completely.
Length ball outside off, Willey looks to play it but gets an inside edge to mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball on the stumps, shaping in a bit, well defended.
Length ball outside off, punched to the man at point for a single.
Fullish ball outside off, driven through the covers.
BEATEN! Jordan is beaten by the shortish ball that swings away from the outside edge of his bat.
CHRIS JORDAN is the new man in.

OUT! POUCHED! Short outside off, Dawson was a bit late pulling it and gets a top edge. The ball is scooped high and goes straight to the man at mid-wicket. Umar Gul does not let his side down and takes the catch. Pakistan are on a roll.
Leg bye! Shortish on leg stump, Willey misses the flick but is struck on the pads as the ball goes to the leg side. They get a leg bye.
Shortish around off, Dawson makes room and steers it down to third man for a single.
Good yorker outside off, dug out towards the covers.
Full and wide outside off, Willey plays a scorching square drive over backward point. The fielder over there leaps but it just goes over him towards the deep. Brace taken.
Good length on off, blocked nicely by getting right behind the line.
Another slower ball outside off, Willey initially thinks of going after it but leaves at the last moment.
DAVID WILLEY is the next batsman in.

OUT! HASAN STRIKES BACK! Another slower ball wicket for Pakistan today. This was served on a length outside off, slow cutter from Ali and Woakes flashes at it. Gets a thick inside edge that crashes on to the stumps. Pakistan chipping away at the wickets in the end overs.

FOUR! CLEAN STRIKE! Fuller outside off, Woakes gets underneath it and lobs it just over the leaping bowler. Mid off was in the circle and it went over the infield easily. Good start to the over for England.
Slower bouncer on leg stump, Woakes makes room and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Dug in short on off, Woakes goes for the pull but is hit on the body off an inside edge.
Shortish on leg stump, tucked off the back foot towards square leg for a run.
Fuller outside off, Woakes lofts it over extra cover. Didn't middle it completely but got enough on it to clear the infield. Sharjeel stops the boundary but the batsmen get three nevertheless.
Length ball outside off, Woakes steers it towards point.
Good length outside off, glided down to third man for a single.
MOHAMMAD AMIR is back on.
Fullish ball, pushed to mid off.
Fuller ball on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket for a couple.
CHRIS WOAKES is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! A brilliant innings by Stokes comes to an end! Back of a length ball outside off, Stokes strikes it hard, scooping it off one knee through the leg side. It goes to Umar Gul at short fine leg who doesn't have to move a muscle to pouch it.
Full on off, driven down the ground for a single.
Short ball on middle and off, pulled through square leg. A man in the deep saves it just inside the ropes.
Fuller ball, driven through the covers for a  single.
HASAN ALI is back on.
FOUR! NUDGED! Down the leg side, Stokes flicks it through the leg side. It got the slightest edge and goes past the keeper to the third man boundary.
FOUR! Fullish ball outside off, Stokes reverse sweeps it fine down the leg side. He finds the gap and makes it to the fence.
Full toss outside off, played to point for a single.
Punched off the backfoot by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Length ball around off, punched through the off side for a single.
Back of a length ball, cut through point.
MOHAMMAD NAWAZ is back on.
Down the leg side, Stokes flicks it to mid-wicket for a couple.
SIX! MASSIVE! Length ball on off, Stokes charges down the wicket and lofts it with the full meat of the bat. He has taken his time but is really opening up here.
Wide. Another short one that passes above Stokes' head and the umpire signals a wide.
Shortish ball around off, Ben knicks it through backward square leg. That was hit hard and Amir tries to take it one-handed but fails. The misfield allows the batsmen to take a brace.
NO BALL! BOUNCER! That was so high that Stokes barely had to bend. The umpire signals a wide.
FOUR! CLUBBED! Length ball outside off, Stokes muscles it through mid-wicket for a boundary. He has taken his time getting settled in but now looks firmly in place.
Fuller delivery on the stumps, worked down the leg side for a single.
Back of a length ball outside off, defended off the front foot to point.
Fuller on middle and off, blocked well off the front foot. Ends another tidy spell from Wasim, 10-0-33-1.
Flatter outside off, Stokes makes room to heave it away and gets a bottom edge on it.
Slider on middle and off, Dawson flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Drifting in on off, tucked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter on off, blocked well from the crease.
6th ODI fifty for BEN STOKES.
FOUR! UP AND OVER! Floats it up around off, Stokes makes room and clubs it easily over mid off. Clean strike and that finds the fence. This has been a very vital knock from the southpaw.
Full outside off, played to mid-wicket. There is a throw at the striker's end and Stokes dives in to make it in.
Length ball outside off, Liam defended it to third man to get off the mark with a single.
The ODI debutant, LIAM DAWSON is the new man in.

OUT! GUL HAS THE LAST LAUGH! Dug in short again around off, Bairstow tries to go for the ramp but doesn't control the stroke at all. Lobs an easy catch towards Rizwan at backward point and the youngster takes it with ease. Timely strike for Pakistan as Jonny was looking ominous.
FOUR! THAT'S SLAPPED AWAY! Slower bouncer on middle and off, Bairstow picks it early and pulls it mercilessly over mid-wicket. Picks his spot and that races away.
Fuller on middle and off, wristed away towards mid on for a single.
The physio is on the field attending to Stokes. He looks to be in pretty bad shape.

OUCH, OUCH, OUCH! Stokes is hurt! Dug in short on off, goes for a meaty pull but ends up getting a thick inside edge that cannons into his vulnerable spot. Down he goes on to the pitch, removing his helmet quickly as well. All English players are amused except Stokes of course.
Outside off and turning away, Bairstow attempts to put bat on ball but is beaten by the spin.
Speared in on leg stump, Bairstow misses the flick and is rapped on the pads. Muted lbw appeal but that was missing leg.
50-run stand between Stokes and Bairstow.
Stokes rocks onto his back foot and punches it. There is a throw at the bolwer's end that allows the batsmen to get a couple.
Fired on outside off, blocked off the back foot.
Flatter outside off, Stokes makes room to slap it away but misses.
Flatter outside off, pushed towards mid off for a single.
A short delivery which has been pulled away for a single.
Stokes has punched it through the off side. There is a direct hit at the bowler's end that allows the batsmen to get a single.
It's like Bairstow could see that coming! Short delivery on middle and off, Bairstow shovels it but the ball doesn't have enough momentum to cross the boundary. The batsmen get a triple.
Missed! Length ball around off, Bairstow goes for a biggie but misses his line and the ball passes over the wicket. Umar Gul has something to say to Bairstow about it.
Fuller ball outside off, flicked through mid-wicket.
Length ball on middle and off, punched off the back foot to mid on for a single.
UMAR GUL is back into the attack.
Sliding across the stumps, punched through the off side. End of another good over by Imad Wasim.
Loopy ball outside off, played to point.
Well bowled! In the corridor outside off, Bairstow gets a leading edge on that one.
Tossed up on the pads, nudged through square leg for single.
Landed outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
Full and flighted on middle and off, driven through mid on for a single.
Drinks break...
Down the leg side, Bairstow defends it off the front foot.
Length ball on the pads, worked through square leg. There is a light-hearted moment when the fielder misfields it at short fine leg and the batsmen get a couple.
Back of a length ball on middle and off, Bairstow looks to cut it but misses and the ball goes over the stumps.
Bairstow has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! DIFFERENT LENGTH, SAME RESULT! Shorter ball on middle and off, Bairstow pulls it through backward square leg. Once again, he finds the gap and the ball crosses the ropes.
FOUR! SLOGGED! Length ball outside off, Bairstow whips it over mid on and the ball races to the boundary.
Full on middle and leg, driven to the man at covers. Poor fielding allows the batsmen to run a couple.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman for a single.
Fuller ball outside off, Stokes strides forward and pushes it through mid off for a single.
Full outside off, pushed to the covers for a single.
Pitch on the pads, Bairstow looks to reverse sweep it but misses and is hit on the pads. The fielding side appeals but the ball was pitching a bit outside leg.
Stokes works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Full on middle and off, driven through mid on.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Length ball on middle and leg, flicked through square leg for a single.
FOUR! BEAUTIFULLY TIMED! Full outside off, Jonny leans forward and drives it through the covers to send the ball racing to the fence.
Full on the pads, driven through mid on for a single.
Fuller ball outside off, Bairstow looks to over hit that one but gets an inside edge to fine leg for a single.
HASAN ALI is back on.
Full on middle and off, driven back to the bowler.
Stokes tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side. The Umpire signals a wide.
Nawaz wants to keep Bairstow on strike and tossed one up on middle and leg but Baistow gets a leading edge to the off side for a single.
Full delivery, driven through mid on for a single.
Flighted on the stumps, pushed to the covers.
SIX! SLOGGED! Straight and full on middle, Stokes dances down the track and lofts it over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Flighted outside off, blocked off the front foot.
Full ball outside off, pushed to the off side.
Fullish ball outside off and Bairstown drives it through the covers.
Fuller ball outside off, pushed to the covers.
Short ball on the stumps, this time Stokes gets his pull and the ball goes to the covers for a single.
OUCH! Short ball on middle, Stokes misjudges the line and misses his pull and the ball strikes him on the body.
Fullish ball outside off, defended off the front foot to the off side.
Floated around off, Bairstow presents a solid front foot defense.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads for a single.
Served outside off, Bairstow punches it off the back foot through the covers for a single.
Slip is in place now.
Flighted on middle, driven to the covers for a single.
On the pads and worked to square leg.
Down the leg side, Stokes looks to flick it but misses and is hit on the pads.
Shortish ball on the stumps, pulled to the leg side for a couple.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Shorter ball outside off, Bairstow looks to defend it off the back foot but the ball slides in between bat and pad.
JONNY BAIRSTOW is the next batsman in.

OUT! NETTED! That concludes Jason Roy's brilliant innings. Slower bouncer outside the off stump, Roy is beaten by the bounce. He goes for a pull and the ball takes a thick top edge. It goes high into the air over square leg. Hasan Ali in the deep, sets himself well and takes a simple catch. Roy lost control and tried to control it towards the end but it was too late.
Shortish ball on middle, pushed to mid on for a single.
FOUR! HOOKED! We are seeing a more fiery Stokes out there. Shorter ball around off, Stokes pulls it hard enough to make it over the fielder at mid on and across the ropes.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
On middle and off, punched off the back foot for a single.
SIX! SLOGGED! Stokes has finally woken up! Full and outside off, Stokes charges forward and smashes it over mid on. He managed to get his bat behind that one and it goes fora  maximum.
Fullish ball outside off, Roy comes forward and slogs it through mid on for a single.
Straighter ball on middle and leg, reverse swept through the off side for a single.
Length ball outside off, pushed off the back foot back down the pitch.
MOHAMMAD NAWAZ comes into the attack.
Good length angled away from around off, pushed towards point.
Length ball outside off, a touch slower in pace and Stokes punches it off the back foot down to long on. Single taken and that brings up the 150 for England.
Length ball slanting away from around off, Roy opens the face to glide it down to third man for a single.
Short around off, doesn't bounce much as Stokes shovels the pull through square leg for a single.
Back of a length around leg stump, worked through square leg for a single.
Good length angled away outside off, dabbed towards backward point.
MOHAMMAD AMIR is back on.
Pitched around off, pushed to the cover region for a single.
The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. The umpire has signalled a wide.
Outside off and showing a lot of spin, Roy looks to play it but get an outside edge. The ball goes to third man and the batsmen get a brace.
Served outside off, driven through the covers.
Loopy ball on the stumps, pushed back to the bowler.
Landed outside off, defended by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full around off, driven through the covers.
Full outside off, driven through the covers.
Pitched on off, the ball spins it to strike Stokes' thigh pad.
Darting in around off, Stokes plays it to point.
50-RUN STAND BETWEEN JASON ROY AND BEN STOKES! A similar ball and Roy looks to loft it again but drags his bat and the ball goes to mid on for a single.

SIX! LOFTED! Full and way down the leg side, Roy makes room for it and lifts it straight up. He knows it is not turning and hits it with the middle of the bat. The ball does straight ahead and across the ground for a massive maximum.
BEATEN! Around the wicket and sliding across the batsman, the ball beats his bottom edge.
Served outside off, driven off the front foot to mid off for a single.
Full outside off, Roy charges forward and defends it well.
Tossed up outside off, driven to point.
Landed on middle and off, flicked to square leg for a single.
Full on off, pushed back to the bowler. Well bowled by Imad.
Flatter ball on middle and off, defended to mid on.
Down the leg side, Roy closes the face of his bat and sweeps it.
Flighted on middle and off, Roy sweeps it to the leg side.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They manage to come back for the second.
Straighter delivery on the pads, flicked to square leg for a single.
Landed on the pads, worked to the on side.
Served on leg, flicked to the leg side for a single.
Driven through mid-on by Jason for a single.
Well bowled! Flighted outside off and sliding in, the ball takes an inside edge off Roy's defence and thuds onto his pads.
Fuller ball, Roy pushes it through the covers. He thinks to take a run but reconsiders.
Served on middle and leg, worked down the leg side for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full delivery on off, driven through the covers for a single.
Pitched on the pads, Roy sweeps it to the leg side to end the over.
Wide. Down the leg side, Roy looks to play it but misses. The umpire signals a wide.
SIX! GRACEFULLY DONE! Roy made that monster of a shot look easy! Full outside off, Roy charges down wicket and lofts it simply but the ball flies over mid on for a maximum.
Full on middle and off, swept through fine leg. The fielder in the deep saves the boundary but the batsmen get a couple.
Shortish ball on middle and off, defended off the back foot to mid on for a single.
Flighted on off, flicked to the leg side for a single.
Around the wicket and floated on middle and off, driven through mid on for a single.
Tossed up on the stumps, flicked through square leg for a single.
Loopy ball outside off, defended with soft hands finely to third man.
Fuller ball on middle, driven through the covers.

NOT OUT! Slider around leg stump, Stokes goes for the reverse sweep and is struck on the pads. Huge appeal for lbw but not given. Looked very close in normal motion but where did that pitch is the question. Imad convinces his skipper to take the review. Replays show that it marginally pitched outside leg stump and that is the end of the discussion. Stokes survives. It may have probably hit the stumps but that doesn't matter.
Pakistan have taken a review for lbw against Stokes.
Fuller on off, Roy bunts it towards mid on.
Drifting away outside off, steered towards point for a single.
Stokes works it down the leg side for a single.
Full on the stumps, Roy gets to the pitch of the ball and plays it to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on leg, Roy goes for the sweep again.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! SWEPT! Roy is in fine form. Down the leg side, he sweeps it through backward square leg and finds the gap to get a boundary.
Full delivery, Roy drives it straight back.
Slides across, Ben looks to play it but misses.
Short on middle and off, defended from within the crease.

FOUR BYES! BEAUTIFUL DELIVERY! Drifting outside off, Stokes is beaten by the bounce. The ball has spin too, turning in and passing the inside edge to slide between bat and off stump. It passes through behind the keeper and crosses the boundary.
Stokes defends it off the front foot with the full face of the bat.
Pitched around off, played off the front foot to the off side.
100 UP FOR ENGLAND! Landed on leg, worked to the leg side for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full on middle and off, driven through mid off.
Drifting in on the stumps, driven through the leg side.
Down the leg side, flicked off the pads for a single.
Full on the stumps, driven down the ground.
5th ODI fifty for JASON ROY.

FOUR! TOP EDGED! Pitched on middle and off, Roy launches into a pre-meditated reverse sweep. He can't really get under iT and the ball takes to top edge to go narrowly past the fielder at short third man to make it to the third man boundary.
Pitched outside off, Roy blocks it with a straight bat to the off side.
Landed outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Full outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
BEN STOKES is the next man in.

OUT! The skipper walks off! Flighted on off, Morgan charges forward and drives that low full toss. It goes straight back to the bowler. Imad is ready to catch it, reverse cupping both hands to secure it. England are looking shaky.
Full on off, driven through mid on.
Full and loopy on middle and leg, Roy digs it out to the leg side. The pitch is showing some good turn here.
IMAD WASIM to bowl.
Pitched outside off, pushed to the covers for a single. The batsmen consider a second but decide against it.
Landed on middle and off, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Floated down the leg side. Roy looks to sweep but but the ball pitches too short and hits his pads.
Short and outside off, Morgan cuts it through point for a single.
Tossed up on the stumps, played to mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball down leg, Roy sweeps it fine down the leg side.
SHOAIB MALIK comes into the attack.
Fulller ball on the pads, played to mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish ball outside off, Eoin cuts it to backward square leg for a single. A good diving stop saves further runs.
Full around off, Morgan dances down the track to drive it through the off side but miscues it to mid on.
In the corridor outside off, Morgan leaves it.
Back of a length ball around off, tapped to mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball on off, defended behind the line of the delivery.
Full ball on off, driven to mid on for a single.
Well bowled! Fullish in length and outside off, the ball whispers past the bat's outside edge.
Roy lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Fullish ball outside off, pushed to point.
FOUR! EDGED! Roy would have been in real trouble had there been a second slip. Length ball outside off, the ball takes an outside edge and goes past the slips to the third man boundary.
FOUR! 1000 RUNS FOR JASON ROY! Full outside off, Roy drives it through mid off and the ball races across the ropes.

FOUR! Beautifully done! Morgan plays it patient and it pays off! He waits for the shortish ball wide outside off and cuts it square. It goes past the fielder and to the boundary at backward square leg.
The skipper lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Length ball outside off, Morgan leaves it.
In the corridor outside off again, left alone.
Morgan shoulders arms to let that one go past his off stump.
Length ball outside off, Roy looks to play it with a straight bat but opens the face at the last moment to guide it to third man for a single.
POWER PLAY 2 has been signalled - 4 players can now be allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
BEATEN! Good length ball outside off, Morgan looks to play it but the ball swings away and beats the outside edge of his bat.
Morgan has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! SMASHED! Morgan makes good use of the free hit. Full outside off, he bounds forward and drives it hard across the ground and through mid off for a boundary.
Free Hit coming up.
Full on middle, Morgan drives it through mid on. The umpire has sigalled a no ball for over-stepping.
Length ball on middle and off, played off the front foot and back to the bowler.
EOIN MORGAN is the next batsman in.

OUT! THE DANGERMAN DEPARTS! Fullish ball outside off, Root looks to drive it through the covers. The ball comes back in and is just enough to take an inside edge. It is just enough to deflect the ball inwards and it moves back in to crash into the woodwork. Hasan has just scored a big wicket for Pakistan.
FOUR! Delicately done! Down the leg side, Roy flicks is finely down the leg side and across the boundary at fine leg.
Fuller ball outside off, helped to third man for a single.
FOUR! One bounce and across the fence! Shortish ball on off, Root hooks it through the leg side. The man in the deep has been moved and the ball makes it easily across the square leg boundary.
Back of a length ball on off, punched off the back foot back down the pitch.
Shortish in length around off, Roy half-pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball outside off, Roy goes back and pushes it back to the bowler.
UMAR GUL replaces Mohammad Amir.
Fullish ball outside off, driven through the covers.
On the pads, Roy flicks it through the leg side for a single.
Length ball outside off, Root brings his body forward and punches is off the back foot to the covers for a triple.
50 UP FOR ENGLAND! Fuller ball outside off, Roy guides it through third man for a single.
Good contest shaping up here. Roy comes down the ground to flick it but the ball swings in and hits him on the pads.
Down the leg side, Roy works it through the on side for a couple.
Length ball outside off, Roy  plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man for a single.
Full delivery outside off, Root drives it through the covers for a single.
Short length ball around off, Roy stands tall and defends it to the leg side for a single.
Fuller ball on middle and off, worked to mid-wicket.
Shortish ball outside off, Roy goes back in the crease to block it but the ball shapes in and passes between the bat and body.
Very full delivery on middle and leg, Roy swivels in the crease to flick it finely through fine leg for a couple.
Touch short of a full length and not much bounce, it is pitched outside off. Root defends it off the back foot.
Full on the pads, Roy nudges it fine down the leg side for a single.
Fuller ball on the stumps, played to mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, Roy looks to push it to the off side but the ball takes an inside edge and hits him on the pads.
Full on middle and leg, Roy  failed to make contact and was hit low on the pads.
FOUR LEG BYES! Yorker down the leg side, Roy looks to flick it but it goes off the pads and slides down the leg side and across the fine leg boundary.
HASAN ALI comes on to bowl.
Root chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
JOE ROOT is the new man in.

OUT! Amir gets his man! Fullish ball outside off, Hales is lured out once more. He drives it hard and the ball takes off from the inside half of the bat and carries to Shoaib Malik at mid on. The ball isn't too high up and Shoaib takes a comfortable two-handed catch. England were off to a quick start but have lost their first man.
Full ball around off, driven through the covers.
FOUR! Third times the charm! Shortish ball outside off, Hales looks to play it through the off side again but this time the ball takes an outside edge to go to the third man boundary.
FOUR! Hales does it again! Fullish ball outside off, Hales opens the face of his bat slightly and drives it through point. He finds the gap and the ball races across the ropes.
FOUR! Clobbered! Hales is rock solid on his front foot. Fuller ball outside off, Hales drives it with the full meat of his bat to send the ball arrowing through the covers to the boundary.
BEATEN! Length ball on middle, Roy looks to defend it but misses the line. The ball swings in to beat his outside edge and thuds into his thigh pad.
Back of a length ball around off, Hales whips it through mid-wicket. He finds the gap and the batsmen get a triple.
Length ball on the pads, flicked through point.
FOUR! PUNCHED! Hales shows great adaptabitiy! Short ball outside off, Hales is taken aback by the bounce but recovers well to punch it through the covers to send the ball bouncing to the fence.
Fuller delivery outside off, calmly defended off the front foot back to the bowler.
Length ball on middle and leg, worked to the leg side for a single.
Short on off, Hales goes for the pull but misses.
Shortish outside off, crunched off the back foot to the off side.
Length ball outside off, Hales bunts it down the track to the bowler.
Good length around off, Hales jams it back to the bowler.
FOUR! SHOT! Full and wide outside off, Hales reaches out to that one and slaps it through extra cover for a boundary.
Fuller outside off, pushed off the front foot towards mid off.
Slower delivery around off, Roy looks to play it but is struck on the thigh pad.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Another shortish delivery, Roy looks to pull but sends the ball fine down the leg side and across the ropes.
FOUR! WHIPPED! Short ball on middle and off, pulled through mid-wicket and the ball races away for a boundary.
Good length ball outside off, Roy shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full ball on off, driven straight down the ground.
Full delivery, angling away, Roy looks to drive but gets an outside edge to third man for a single.
Pitched around middle and leg, played to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Edged and raced away! Length delivery, straightening a touch after pitching, Roy looks to play across the line but gets an inside edge past keeper, who dives to his left but fails to stop. The ball races away to the fence. First runs on board...
LBW APPEAL! Pitched around leg, shaping back in, Roy looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the front pad. Amir appeals but the umpire turns it down.
Angling across Roy, he opts to leave it.
Length delivery, angling across, left alone.
Players are out in the middle. ALEX HALES and JASON ROY will open the batting for England. MOHAMMAD AMIR to bowl the first over. Two slips in place. Let's play...

Pakistan will look to gain some respect by winning this match. They are still out of top 8 rankings, which means that they won't qualify automatically for World Cup 2019. Their batting has not lived upto par and will look to change it this time around. Let's hope we have a thrilling contest between these two sides and it be a cricketing fest. A warm welcome to everyone for the last and final ODI of the series between England and Pakistan! The series will conclude in Wales at Cardiff. England have already won the series and will look to complete the whitewash. They might make some changes to their side to give other players a chance. They have won all the previous matches handsomely and will look to do the same.
